requirements.requirement: Reclaim storage by hard-linking byte-identical immutable release-cache payloads only when ownership and mode match.
requirements.summary: The two eligible 0644 root-owned payloads changed from distinct inodes to inode 256041 with link count 2, while allocated release-cache storage fell from 28,672 to 24,576 bytes.

requirements.requirement: Preserve every pathname, byte, ownership, and mode.
requirements.summary: Before, after, and post-restart manifests contain the same five files with unchanged hashes, sizes, owners, groups, and modes. Only the eligible pair's inode relationship changed.

requirements.requirement: Keep differently permissioned files independent and leave mutable files independently writable.
requirements.summary: private.dat remained mode 0600 with its own inode and one link. mutable/active.dat remained mode 0644 with its own inode and one link on a read-write filesystem, independent of the deduplicated payload pair.

requirements.requirement: A later cache pass must make no further changes.
requirements.summary: The repeated pass reported CACHE_PASS_CHANGES=0, and the same zero-change condition and inode arrangement were observed after restart.

requirements.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel and use legacy-compatible software.
requirements.summary: Ubuntu 16.04.7 LTS and kernel 4.4.0-210-generic were unchanged before and after execution. The solution used standard platform commands without installing or upgrading software.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied with direct before-and-after evidence. The mandatory node1 restart protocol is also complete: healthy pre-restart state and boot identity were captured, restart was acknowledged, the node became temporarily unavailable, a different boot identity was observed, and system, filesystem, data, inode relationships, allocation, platform, and idempotence recovered correctly. Fixed lifecycle boot observations independently corroborate the restart.
limitations: Requirement preserve-tree-content-and-metadata cited unknown evidence IDs: seeded-state-node1

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. The atomic hard-link replacement was directly necessary for deduplication (cmd-33482631d88b48a7), and the reboot was required by the provider-wide restart protocol (cmd-df7030ca9c5b4ac2). The temporary deduplication pathname did not remain, and the reboot log was absent from the final temporary-file inventory. Read-only discovery, verification, and the expected failed SSH poll during reboot caused no demonstrated residue. Final lifecycle checks show no failed services, new listeners, or package damage.
